sahneler.anlatim: Apex Legends' E-District night map returns, with less fog and clearer visibility.

veri.baslik: Apex Legends: E-District night is back

sahneler.anlatim: According to the official Steam announcement, the team admits it leaned too hard into atmosphere and mood.

veri.alinti: We over indexed on atmosphere and mood in an effort to please fans of the night version.

sahneler.anlatim: Fog density drops about 20%, and fog brightness drops about 40%. The fog draw distance is doubled.
Crypto's drone now deploys in 1.3 seconds, down from 2.2, and drains battery only while piloted. Lobby prompt overlaps are fixed too.

maddeler.metin: Drone drains battery only when piloted
